limits: One Blue training seed; four paired cases per opponent; action rows are correlated.
Completed means the pending action reached its execution tick, not successful remediation.
Pre/post target changes span the full multi-agent step and do not establish action causality.
Global compromised state is diagnostic ground truth, not Blue's observation.
Monitor also runs automatically every tick; explicit Monitor choices do not measure sensor coverage.
Green failure counts have no attempted-action denominator; report counts, not rates.
On-policy states diverge; these are not same-state action preference tests.
The four-root21000 cases are exploratory and do not replace the64-case checkpoint score panels.

protocol.interpretation: Exploratory case study: four paired episodes per opponent, one trained Blue lineage. Paired checkpoint cases share layout/root within an opponent; FSM and learned opponents use different RNG contracts. Every archived learned Red is unseen during this FSM-only Blue training. These traces do not estimate population behavior or identify optimization causality.
protocol.question: What decisions and consequences change between the primary and final Blue checkpoints against FSM and a strong archived learned Red?
requirements: Retain exact source, checkpoint, sidecar, topology, reference evaluation and episode identities.
Require each new return to equal its retained canonical same-case return; retain discrepancies and withhold behavioral interpretation on mismatch.
Separate submitted actions, genuine idle decisions, forced busy Sleep, pending actions and completed actions.
Normalize choices by genuine decision opportunities and report legal action and owned host/subnet opportunities.
Treat Blue observations as available evidence and simulator compromise state as diagnostic ground truth; do not conflate them.
Report reward components, Green consequences, target state changes and route occupancy alongside frequencies.
Report incomplete cells as missing; do not substitute another checkpoint or opponent.
protocol.selection: The first reserved episode root and all four declared evaluation layouts; chosen by index before inspecting case returns. No checkpoint or episode is selected by its outcome.
